headline: EPS falls sequentially but swings to a profit year-over-year
summary_short: ALTEOGEN reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ₩531, down 60.4% q/q from ₩1,340 but swinging from a ₩620 per-share loss a year earlier.
summary_long: EPS of ₩531 fell 60.4% sequentially from ₩1,340 but swung from a ₩620 per-share loss in the year-ago quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
